name: clixo-c2p-app
description: 📝 Clixo - Ultra-secure text sharing and markdown editor with Supabase sync, password encryption & self-destruct timers.

paragraphs: Clixo is a modern, privacy-focused text sharing platform and live Markdown editor. Engineered for developers, writers, and security-conscious individuals, Clixo lets you create, format, and securely distribute notes with real-time cloud database synchronization, cryptographic password locking, and self-destructing expiration timers.
features: 🔒 Cryptographic Password Protection: Restrict reading and editing access with password authentication. Protect sensitive code snippets, credentials, or private drafts.

⏱️ Ephemeral Self-Destruct Timers: Configure custom note lifespans (1 min, 5 min, 15 min, 1 hour, 4 hours, 24 hours). Once the countdown expires, notes are permanently purged from both cloud and client stores.
🌐 Real-Time Database Sync (Supabase): Powered by PostgreSQL on Supabase for cross-device syncing, paired with local-first localStorage caching for zero-latency offline editing.
✍️ Dual-Pane Live Markdown Studio: Write with a full Markdown formatting toolbar (bold, italic, code blocks, tables, task lists) and view immediate live side-by-side rendered output.
🎨 Glassmorphic Cyber Aesthetics: Built with Tailwind CSS and modern CSS variables, featuring ambient glowing backgrounds, smooth transitions, and seamless Dark/Light theme switching.
